_comment: Built-in demo targets. Positions/proper motions from CDS Sesame (J2000), except WISE 0855 whose challenge-supplied coordinates were verified against SPHEREx data to correspond to epoch ~2010.5. pm in mas/yr (pmra = mu_alpha*cos(dec)).

targets.name: Barnard's Star
targets.note: Fastest-moving star on the sky (~10.4 arcsec/yr).

targets.name: Epsilon Indi B
targets.note: A pair of brown dwarfs (Ba/Bb) orbiting the star Epsilon Indi A.

targets.name: WISE 0855-0714
targets.note: Coldest known brown dwarf; invisible in optical (no Gaia match). ~2 arcmin west of the challenge coordinates by 2025.

targets.name: RW Aurigae
targets.note: Irregular variable with deep dimming events.

targets.name: R Draconis
targets.note: Long-period variable (~246 d) in the SPHEREx north ecliptic pole deep field (thousands of images).
